notes:
Company background: Subscriptly is a mid-market subscription billing SaaS (Stripe + Zuora connectors) serving SMB to mid-market SaaS customers. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API as first step, then Dedicated reserved capacity for production.

Primary problem / ask: build a chat-based support assistant for billing and subscription flows (invoices, proration, cancellations, refunds, payment failures). Must support tool calling to Stripe/Zuora and emit deterministic structured JSON for orchestration. Streaming responses required for agent experience (token-level streaming + progressive tool-call triggers).

Performance requirements: target p95 latency <= 300ms for short-turn responses; goal p50 ~150ms. Peak concurrent agents ~100-150 during end-of-month; throughput down-select needed. Cost sensitive but willing to commit to Dedicated if unit economics and latency SLOs met.

Security / compliance: must support SSO/SAML for staff, audit logging for all requests and tool calls, KMS integration for encryption keys, and data residency in NA. SOC2 reported required; ISO27001 nice-to-have.

Model + routing preferences: prefer Redwood-verified open models for cost; need fallbacks (smaller quantized variants) when Dedicated pool saturated. Strong interest in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching/caching) to reduce per-ticket cost.

POC plan: 2-week Hosted API POC (keys provided) to validate streaming, tool-calling reliability, and structured JSON outputs using sanitized production-like ticket dataset. After POC, request Dedicated pricing with capacity for ~150 concurrent sessions and SLA options.

Recent interactions: demo (2026-02-18) with AE Maya + SE Liam: walked through streaming demo, tool calling flow to Stripe sandbox, and structured output schema. Head of Product quote: "We need deterministic JSON outputs — we can’t have hallucinated transaction IDs or ambiguous state." Security team sent initial questionnaire (link in Drive). SE to run load test for 150 concurrent agent sessions against Hosted API.

Outstanding asks: Hosted API POC keys + example repo for Stripe/Zuora connectors, sample structured JSON schemas, Dedicated pricing tiers and SLA, timeline for SSO/SAML setup and audit-log delivery.

Short notes / shorthand:

- Key metrics to validate: p95 latency, structured output accuracy (>98%), tool-call success rate, cost per ticket.
- Contact: Michael Alvarez, Head of Product (michael@subscriptly.com) — prefers demos w/ metrics.
